articles.title: Bitcoin slides below $82,000 as AI doubts return, with DeFi tokens leading declines
articles.snippet: Bitcoin as much as 2.9% to around $81,600 as Nasdaq futures dropped, while the CoinDesk 80 lost 3.5% and DeFi index slid 6%.

articles.title: Crypto traders price India telecoms company Reliance Jio's IPO at about $110 billion
articles.snippet: The pre-IPO Jio contract on Bitget is trading near $12, a roughly 4% premium on the top price band, as India’s largest public offering remains open for subscription.

articles.title: Irish cenbank fines Coinbase arm $3.6M for oversight, safeguard failures
articles.snippet: According to the Central Bank of Ireland, Coinbase Ireland had agreed with the facts around the enforcement action and will be subject to fines and sanctions upon approval by a high court.

articles.title: CryptoQuant CEO calls rising Bitcoin hashrate ‘indirect bullish signal’ from institutions
articles.snippet: Public miners backed by major TradFi players are coming back online, boosting Bitcoin’s hashrate, a positive sign for BTC’s fundamentals, according to CryptoQuant’s Ki Young Ju.

articles.title: PHP flaw draws millions of exploit attempts, Cloudflare CEO warns
articles.snippet: Cloudflare’s Matthew Prince said the network saw thousands of exploit attempts even before the PHP vulnerability was publicly disclosed.
